--------------------------------------------------------------
3. Online players loaded at run time (not bundled)
--------------------------------------------------------------

YouTube IFrame Player API and the Vimeo Player API are loaded from their
official servers only when such videos are played. Their use is subject to
the YouTube Terms of Service and the Vimeo Terms of Service respectively.
yt-dlp is not included; users may install it separately.
